title: Clean junk files with BleachBit
summary: Use BleachBit to delete junk files and free up disk space. Always preview first to ensure you don't delete important data.

steps.explain: Perform the clean-up operation and delete files for specific cleaners.

placeholders.name: CLEANER_OPTIONS
placeholders.description: Space-separated list of cleaner options, e.g., 'firefox.cache firefox.cookies'

steps.expect: Files are deleted and disk space is freed.

warnings: This action permanently deletes files. Always use --preview first to check what will be removed.

rollback.explain: There is no built-in undo for BleachBit deletions. Restore from backup if available.
